title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
summary: A pilot stranded in the desert meets a small boy who has travelled from a tiny planet. Through the boy's stories of the strange adults and the one rose he left behind, the book looks at love and what grown-ups forget.
readIf: you like short, gentle books that read like fables and reward a second look as an adult.
skipIf: you want a firm plot, action or a fully developed fantasy world.

pairings.reason: Another short, dreamlike classic where odd encounters are really a way of poking at how grown-ups think.
A small, tender story about friendship and loss that works for children and adults alike.
Also a slim fable-like book about following what matters most, though more direct about its lessons.
